purpose: Define comparable scanner, datasource, query and client measurements before search optimization begins.
implementationStatus: The contract and negative validation are frozen. The W03-S04 feasibility spike measured only the implemented in-process matching layer; later layers and cohorts remain planned until their owning scopes implement them.

ownership.externalBaseline: ripgrep, pinned by recorded version, revision and binary SHA-256

layerBoundaries.matching_kernel_equivalent_in_process_si: One process traverses the declared eligible manifest, reads and decodes input, matches, normalizes the declared result unit, and writes to the equivalent sink. It excludes datasource, query-engine, service and client transport work.
layerBoundaries.datasource_chunks: Includes source traversal/read/decode/match work, chunk production and the datasource writer boundary. It excludes query compilation, query execution, service startup and client transport.
layerBoundaries.compiled_query: Includes datasource work plus query compilation and execution through the declared result sink. It excludes cold process startup unless startup is explicitly the layer under test.
layerBoundaries.warm_service_end_to_end: Starts from a ready service and times request admission through first client-visible result and terminal completion. Source, query, bridge and output costs remain separately recorded.
layerBoundaries.cold_client_end_to_end: Includes client and service process startup, configuration, transport, query execution, first client-visible result and terminal completion. Filesystem cache state must still be labeled independently.

resultUnits.cardinality: one row per selected match occurrence
resultUnits.equality: normalized path, byte/character coordinate contract, matched span and pattern identity

resultUnits.cardinality: one row per selected matching line
resultUnits.equality: normalized path, line coordinate and line content

resultUnits.cardinality: one row per eligible file with at least one match
one row per declared count key
resultUnits.equality: same key and exact count; line and occurrence counts are distinct units
normalized occurrence identity plus declared pattern label

resultUnits.cardinality: one row per declared capture result
resultUnits.equality: normalized occurrence identity, capture name/index and captured value

resultUnits.cardinality: one row per occurrence with its bounded context window
resultUnits.equality: occurrence identity plus normalized context window
normalized path, byte offset, matched bytes and mask/signature identity

resultUnits.cardinality: one row per successfully parsed selected record
resultUnits.equality: normalized source identity, record coordinate and parsed value

resultUnits.cardinality: one row per verified diagnostic relation
resultUnits.equality: normalized source, target, relation kind and location

resultUnits.cardinality: one row per complete query result
resultUnits.equality: the owning query contract's canonical row identity and order

resultUnits.cardinality: exactly one terminal record per execution
resultUnits.equality: terminal outcome, reason, completeness and exact counters

resultUnits.cardinality: defined by the optional extension contract
resultUnits.equality: the extension's independently versioned canonical identity

baseline.invocationRule: Use one process and one traversal per trial for the complete registered pattern set.
baseline.semanticRule: Compare only when the baseline output is normalized to the same declared result unit; matching lines, line counts and occurrences are not interchangeable.

candidate.invocationRule: Record the complete request, resolved scope and all result rows or terminal outcome for every trial.

commands.purpose: Normal development loop for Search behavior and harness validation
Scope-completion and explicitly high-impact repository regression gate
Verify fixture, baseline metadata, output normalization and contract completeness
Run only a registered measurement plan and emit raw paired trial records

timingBoundaries.scannerOnly: Start immediately before eligible traversal/open/read and stop after the normalized result sink has accepted output. Include traversal, file open/read, decoding, matching, result mapping and output serialization/hash; exclude datasource/query/client layers.
timingBoundaries.datasourceChunks: Start at source traversal and stop after the datasource chunk writer has accepted the final chunk. Include source and writer costs; exclude query compilation, query execution and client transport.
timingBoundaries.compiledQuery: Start at query compilation and stop after the terminal query result is accepted. Record datasource timing separately; do not hide compilation or output work in a scanner-only claim.
timingBoundaries.warmServiceEndToEnd: Start when a request is submitted to a ready service and stop after the first client-visible result and terminal outcome have been recorded. Report first-result and terminal latency separately.
timingBoundaries.coldClientEndToEnd: Start before launching the client/service process and stop after the terminal outcome. Include startup, configuration, transport and output; never infer filesystem cache state from process coldness.

trialPolicy.order: Randomized paired baseline,candidate blocks; record first invocation for every trial.

statistics.aggregate: geometric mean of registered per-cell median ratios
statistics.variance: retain raw durations and report minimum, maximum, median and MAD or IQR
statistics.confidenceIntervals: Use bootstrap intervals only when the report records the resampling method and seed; otherwise report no interval rather than inventing one.
statistics.outliers: Retain all raw values. Exclusion requires a pre-registered environmental-fault rule and the original run record.

trialPolicy.failedRun: Retain terminal failure, cancellation and partial records, but exclude their durations from performance aggregates and reject them as complete measurements.

cacheLabels.definition: Filesystem cache was placed in a documented cold state using a recorded, authorized mechanism; include host evidence.
The registered workload was warmed by the documented procedure and cache state was not reset between the warm-up and measured trial; include host evidence.
Filesystem cache was not controlled or verified.

rejectionRules: Reject different eligible sets or eligible byte counts without an explained contract reason.
Reject a scope identifier or result unit that does not match the registered cell.
Reject a cell without a versioned baseline and candidate identity.
Reject a zero-byte scan, including an empty-result workload, because input eligibility was not proven.
Reject missing or non-positive eligible input manifest and result hashes.
Reject comparing rg matching lines with Search occurrences.
Reject comparing rg count-lines with Search count-occurrences.
Reject dropping setup, traversal or output costs from an end-to-end claim.
Reject a cancelled, partial or budget-limited run as complete.
Reject an unrecorded tool version, binary digest, source digest or invocation.
Reject a multi-pattern baseline that unnecessarily scans once per pattern.
Reject calling unknown filesystem cache state cold.
Reject selecting only fast workloads after results are known.
Reject fewer than seven complete measured trials per cell.
Reject duplicate, unordered or non-finite trial durations.

thresholds.rule: Targets are evaluated only after semantic parity and registered cohort coverage pass. W03-S04 feasibility measurements are retained as observations and do not establish these thresholds.

completionRule: No optimization or superiority claim is valid until the registered workload has an accepted scope manifest, equivalent result unit, complete baseline and candidate outputs, at least seven paired trials per cell, and the required layer/cohort evidence.
